products.name: Browse AI
products.note: Web scraping automation; data extraction; monitoring; terms-of-service compliance risk

profile_text.body:
Browse AI is a no-code web scraping and data monitoring platform founded in 2020. The company describes itself as the leading data scraper, serving users worldwide who need to scrape, extract, monitor, and integrate data from websites without writing code. Its approach allows users to point the tool at a webpage, after which the platform's AI structures the extracted data automatically, with the option for manual customization.

The core product, also called Browse AI, falls in the automation and agents category and offers features including dynamic content capture, built-in bot evasion, proxy management, automatic retries, and rate limiting. The platform also provides website change detection that the company says adapts automatically when a site's structure changes, keeping extracted data accurate over time. Users can set up live monitors to receive alerts when specified changes occur on a page, and the tool connects to external workflows and databases through a REST API. Pre-built scraping robots are available for specific sites and use cases, including product and pricing data from Best Buy and AI tool listings from directories such as Futurepedia and Future Tools.

The held facts record no litigation, MCP server registrations, SEC filings, or patent activity associated with Browse AI. The product entry notes a terms-of-service compliance risk, which reflects a general concern in web scraping that automated data extraction may conflict with the usage policies of the sites being scraped.
